div.head: ECf Prol. 1
div.ab: Electis igitur de singulis totius patrie comitatibus duodecim, iureiurando inprimis coram eo sanxerunt, ut quoad possent, recto tramite incedentes, legum suarum ac consuetudinum sancita edicerent, nil pretermittentes, nil preuaricando commutantes.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 627 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.
Liebermann’s upright (roman) letter a after “duodecim” refers to his explanatory notes, the Erklärungen (printed as Gesetze III; his note on p. 627 calls it “Band II”), which are not yet added here.
There is no note 13 on this page: after note 12 Liebermann’s numbering goes on at 14, and “singulis” carries his footnote g.

note.seg: aus 32 je 12 = 384 [!]; singuli heisst auch 7, 1 f. nicht etwa omnes; geschah die Wahl daheim oder aus den sapientes (o. Anm. e) vor Wilhelm I.? Die Maske einer Weisthum gebenden Jury lässt Verf. später fallen

12 from each of 32 = 384 [!]; singuli at 7, 1 f. too does not mean, say, omnes; did the election take place at home, or from among the sapientes (above, note e) before William I? The author later drops the mask of a jury declaring the law

Verfasser vergisst die Rechtsverschiedenheit zwischen den Grafschaften oder wenigstens zwischen Westsachsen, Mercien, Denalagu; er beschränkt die Aussage über Dänisches und die Bitte um Englisches Recht 30. 34, 1 nicht auf nur je einen Theil dieser Jury; er ignorirt die Eigenheit der Myrcnalagu

the author forgets the differences of law between the shires, or at least between Wessex, Mercia and the Danelaw; he does not confine the statement about Danish law, and the plea for English law, at 30. 34, 1, to one part only of this jury; he ignores the particular character of the Myrcnalagu

hier fügt zu Ce, vergeblich Lond, u. 34, 1a, zu bessern versuchend, und (da Ealdred 1069 starb, Hugo erst 1075 geweiht ward) in sich widersprechend: Aldredus autem Eboracensis archiepiscopus, qui regem Willelmum coronauerat, et Hugo Londoniensis episcopus per preceptum regis scripserunt propriis manibus omnia que predicti iurati dixerunt.

here Ce adds, trying in vain to improve on Lond (below, 34, 1a), and contradicting itself (since Ealdred died in 1069 and Hugh was only consecrated in 1075): Aldredus autem Eboracensis archiepiscopus, qui regem Willelmum coronauerat, et Hugo Londoniensis episcopus per preceptum regis scripserunt propriis manibus omnia que predicti iurati dixerunt.
